notes: Class EX, not E0/E3 (deliberate deviation, HiCExplorer 4 fix 2, project owner 2026-11-06): hicDifferentialTAD and hicInterIntraTAD cut one corrected TAD geometry for cool and h5, where 3.7.6 dropped the last bin of the next TAD from the cool right block, used a stale index for the left block of the last TAD (empty on h5, a wrong block on cool) and gave the second TAD of a two-TAD chromosome no left block. The right and last-TAD left columns, and with them the accepted/rejected split, therefore differ from 3.7.6 and there is no Python output to compare with; the intra-TAD columns are unchanged. The geometry is pinned by test_hicDifferentialTAD.py / test_hicInterIntraTAD.py (regenerated tables, p-values checked against scipy.stats.ranksums on the raw blocks) and cpp/tests/test_tad_contacts.cpp. The invocation of test_cool_all_single_core.

Only the intra-TAD test decides, so --modeReject has no effect. 91 of 140 rejected. --threads 4: the Python's output on the full TAD file is identical at 1, 4, 11 and 16 processes, measured 2026-09-13. Since the special functions are Boost.Math's and no longer the routines scipy uses, the last one or two bits of the p-values differ from 3.7.6 (largest relative difference 2.4e-15 over the corpus): the text outputs are declared E3 (relative 1e-12 on the float columns; chromosome, coordinates, names and comment lines exactly) instead of E0, and the called regions are compared on their first four columns, which keeps the accepted and rejected sets exact. HiCExplorer 4 fix 2 (TAD geometry, project owner 2026-11-06): the left and right p-value columns of the text tables differ from 3.7.6, so only the called regions (E5), which depend on the intra-TAD test alone in this mode, are compared with the Python; the intra-TAD columns are pinned by test_hicDifferentialTAD.py::test_cool_all_single_core_intra_TAD against the regenerated mode_intra-TAD tables.
